_purpose: Offline directory for the Where to Go screen. Bundled static JSON, no API.
_ui_requirement: Every entry must render a 'Call to confirm hours before you go' line. Hours change and a wasted trip is a real harm for someone without a car.
_confidence_note: confidence=high means taken directly from the operating agency's own site. confidence=medium means from a third-party aggregator and NOT yet confirmed at the agency source. Do not ship a medium entry without verifying it.

county_offices.agency: Santa Clara County Social Services Agency, Department of Employment and Benefit Services

shared.hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Closed on County holidays.
shared.drop_box_note: Document drop boxes are outside every location, so you can submit paperwork without waiting in line.
shared.accessibility_note: Call this number to request an interpreter, help filling out forms, or a disability accommodation. You have a right to ask.

phones.label: If you already receive CalFresh, CalWORKs, General Assistance, CAPI, or Refugee Cash Assistance

county_offices.phone_tip: The fastest way to reach your worker is to call them directly. Their name and number are printed in the top right corner of the last Notice of Action you received.

locations.name: Benefit Assistance Center
locations.purpose: Apply for benefits. Start here if you are new.

locations.name: Continuing Benefit Services
locations.purpose: For cases already open. Recertifications and status reports.

locations.name: North County Office
locations.note: Closest office for CA-16 residents in Mountain View, Los Altos, Palo Alto, and Sunnyvale.

appeals._purpose: Used by the 'How to appeal' section of Notice Detail. This is the highest-stakes data in the file.
appeals.how: Instructions are printed on the back of the Notice of Action itself. Fill out the back of the notice and send or take it to the Appeals Unit.

appeals_unit.name: Appeals Unit, County of Santa Clara Social Services

appeals.ombuds_note: Before filing a hearing you can ask your worker, then a supervisor, then request a free confidential case review from the County Ombuds office.
